api.base_url: https://{accountId}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com/services/rest (record/v1, query/v1/suiteql). Token URL https://{accountId}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com/services/rest/auth/oauth2/v1/token (from Nango providers.yaml netsuite-client-credentials; base path itself UNVERIFIED on a fetched Oracle page, the Oracle overview page checked omitted base URL)
api.openapi_spec_url: UNVERIFIED (per-account metadata-catalog at /services/rest/record/v1/metadata-catalog serves OpenAPI 3; not confirmed on a fetched page)

auth.token_lifetime: access token lifetime UNVERIFIED; public-client refresh token validity configurable 1-720 hours (default 48), max token-rotation window 1-720 hours (default 168)
auth.refresh: Refresh token via authorization code grant; Client Credentials (Machine to Machine) grant is also available on the integration record (M2M assertion details UNVERIFIED on a fetched page)

access_requirements.partner_program_name: SuiteCloud Developer Network (SDN) is only needed for SuiteApp distribution / free dev account; UNVERIFIED page
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Not required for REST integration records created inside the customer account
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Admin (or user with Integration Application permission) goes to Setup > Integration > Manage Integrations > New, sets State Enabled, ticks Authorization Code Grant (https redirect URI) and/or Client Credentials (M2M), ticks REST Web Services scope, saves, and copies client ID and secret (shown only once). Also enable REST Web Services feature and give the authorizing user a role with REST Web Services + record permissions.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: No fee found; customer's concurrency limit is account-level
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Same day if customer admin cooperates; no vendor approval

sandbox.how_to_get: Customer sandbox account (paid add-on to customer) or SDN developer account; no public self-signup UNVERIFIED

rate_limits: Concurrency governed at account level for SOAP+RESTlet+REST combined: base by service tier Standard 5, Premium 15, Enterprise 20, Ultimate 20 (contracts since June 2020), +10 per SuiteCloud Plus license; governanceLimits operation reports limit; exceeding returns concurrency error
incremental_sync: SuiteQL WHERE lastModifiedDate > :cursor via POST /services/rest/query/v1/suiteql (Prefer: transient); or REST record collection q filter on lastModifiedDate. (Filter syntax UNVERIFIED on fetched page.) No native CDC.

unified_api_coverage.merge_dev: unverified (netsuite string not found in merge.dev/integrations HTML, page may be JS-rendered)
unified_api_coverage.airbyte_source: yes, source-netsuite (community) and source-netsuite-enterprise (certified) in connectors.airbyte.com oss_registry.json

blockers: Each customer must create its own integration record and role (no marketplace shortcut)
Low default concurrency (5 on Standard tier) limits parallel pulls
